statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend; verified Gulf energy and Red Sea disruptions keep Stress extreme, while no live NQ path confirms persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH because current evidence is concentrated in energy, shipping, and reopening-gap risk rather than an observed one-way NQ price path.
headline: Weekend energy disruption keeps Stress extreme while closed NQ leaves Tail low
body: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remains shut after a drone attack, Houthis hold Perim at Bab el-Mandeb, and tanker freight costs are at record highs. Friday's Nasdaq rose 0.96%; weekend closure prevents live confirmation of pathological NQ price structure.

lookbackSummary: From 08:00 UTC Friday through 07:00 UTC Saturday, Tail was mostly WATCH during Friday's active session, eased after the close, and stayed low during the weekend shutdown. Stress remained extreme as Gulf energy and Red Sea disruptions intensified.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain inside the weekend NQ closure. Energy and shipping disruption keep Stress extreme; Tail stays below WATCH because no live price path can confirm persistent mean-reversion failure.

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed for the weekend. The Saudi pipeline shutdown and Perim/Bab el-Mandeb disruption keep Stress extreme, while no live NQ path can confirm persistent mean-reversion failure.

forecast.analysis: Damage assessment on the East-West pipeline is the nearest checkpoint. Continued closure would preserve reopening-gap risk; the index path remains unobserved while NQ is shut.

news.title: Saudis shut down oil pipeline as Houthis tighten grip on Red Sea shipping

forecast.analysis: Any verified timeline for restoring Saudi cross-country flows could change gap risk. Without such evidence, Stress stays extreme but Tail remains a conditional reopening risk.
A broader Saudi response or fresh attacks would raise macro stress first. Closed NQ still provides no evidence of shallow pullbacks, failed retracements, or one-way extension.
Record tanker freight costs keep the inflation transmission channel active. Tail remains low because shipping stress is not equivalent to an observed pathological Nasdaq price path.

forecast.analysis: Perim and Bab el-Mandeb access remain a weekend headline checkpoint. Further restriction would raise reopening uncertainty; stabilization would reduce that channel conditionally.

news.title: Saudis shut down oil pipeline as Houthis tighten grip on Red Sea shipping

forecast.analysis: Saudi supply is already unusually constrained. Additional verified physical losses would keep Stress near the ceiling, but future NQ directional efficiency remains unknown.

news.title: Saudi oil supply hits more than three-decade low after Houthi attacks, IEA says

forecast.analysis: The Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea now form a two-corridor energy-risk stack. Any easing in either route would reduce gap pressure before live NQ structure becomes available.
Weekend diplomatic signals are the main potential offset to energy escalation. Credible de-escalation would lower reopening uncertainty; absent that, Stress stays extreme.
A confirmed Saudi repair timetable would be a constructive checkpoint. Continued uncertainty leaves a high-volatility reopening setup without proving a no-retracement Nasdaq path.
Further attacks on Gulf or Red Sea infrastructure would reinforce the catalyst stack. In a closed market, that still raises Stress more directly than Tail.
Friday's positive Nasdaq close is stale session context rather than current structure. Weekend headlines can alter the eventual gap, but no future price response is assumed.

news.title: S&P 500 ends higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets

forecast.analysis: As the weekend progresses, absent new escalation, uncertainty can decay modestly even while energy conditions remain severe. Tail stays tied to later live retracement quality.
If Saudi flows remain impaired into the next news cycle, inflation and rates concerns would stay elevated. That would be a reopening amplifier, not present-tense NQ trend evidence.
Any verified counter-operation around Perim could increase headline volatility. Market-path implications remain conditional until NQ reopens and pullback behavior can be observed.
Freight and insurance costs remain a persistent macro channel. Without another verified deterioration, the forecast does not assume further escalation or a directional Nasdaq reaction.

news.title: Oil tanker rates hit record highs following Iran, US shipping attacks

forecast.analysis: Energy supply tightness may keep rate expectations sensitive into the new week. The closed-market forecast therefore separates macro Stress from unobserved Tail structure.
Official Saudi, Iraqi, Yemeni, Iranian, or U.S. statements could alter weekend risk. Only verified developments would change this conditional assessment.
If no additional supply loss is confirmed, the main risk becomes persistence of the existing disruption rather than a new shock. Tail remains below WATCH while NQ is closed.
Later in the horizon, continued absence of fresh escalation would modestly reduce conditional gap risk. Extreme Stress can still coexist with low Tail until live price discovery resumes.
A worsening shipping or pipeline situation would invalidate the modest easing path and push Stress higher again. The forecast does not presume that deterioration occurs.
With reopening still well beyond this horizon, there is no basis to project one-way NQ continuation. The relevant evidence remains energy security and verified weekend headlines.
Absent a new geopolitical discontinuity, conditional Tail remains low. Any later gap will need confirmation from actual retracements, extensions, and cross-asset alignment after reopening.
The 24-hour horizon ends with NQ still closed. Existing energy disruption keeps macro Stress high, while the next decisive Tail evidence will come only from subsequent live price discovery.
